en.summary: An unconventional idea may be worth exploring today. Stay open-minded while checking whether it is practical enough to use.
en.love: Give each other room to be individual, because a surprising conversation may reveal a useful perspective.
en.career: Innovation works best when you explain your thinking clearly and invite feedback.
en.money: Experiment only within limits you can comfortably manage and keep essential costs separate.
